notes:
I don't have any notes for you yet. My first batch of page requests went over the tool's usage limit and failed, and I wasn't allowed any more calls after that. So I haven't read a single page on Ecclesiastes 12 from any of the approved sites.

Your rules say to report only what the pages actually say and never fill gaps from my own knowledge. With nothing read, anything I wrote now would come from memory without a real source behind it, so I've left the notes out.

If you ask again, I'll fetch the pages a few at a time to stay under the limit, in this order:

1. **Traditional reading, verse by verse:**
   - Enduring Word (enduringword.com/bible-commentary/ecclesiastes-12/)
   - Bible Hub's pages for each verse, which collect Gill, Ellicott, Pulpit, Barnes and Matthew Henry (biblehub.com/commentaries/ecclesiastes/12-1.htm through 12-14.htm)
   - Precept Austin's Ecclesiastes 12 page
2. **Where Protestant traditions differ:**
   - Wesley's Notes (wesley.nnu.edu)
   - Spurgeon (spurgeon.org) and Desiring God
   - Ligonier and The Gospel Coalition
   - Lutheran pages (lcms.org, 1517.org), for example on v. 13's "fear God and keep His commandments" and the law–gospel question
3. **Other views:**
   - NET Bible notes, especially on the imagery in vv. 3–6, "single Shepherd" in v. 11, and whether vv. 9–14 were added by a later editor
   - Bible Odyssey
   - Catholic pages (New Advent, Catholic.com) and Orthodox pages (oca.org), especially on v. 7, "the spirit returns to God"
   - Prosperity or word-of-faith teaching, only if the sites actually discuss this chapter
